Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2525; inconstant:--unstable.
BiblicalUsage: Twice, both in James, both of what cannot settle. The double-minded man is unstable in all his ways; and the tongue can no man tame — an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for unstable carries little weight on its own; its weight is James's cure, ask in faith, and the anchor that holds is God's grip on us, not ours on Him.
RelatedPeople: James, Brother of Jesus; Simon Peter
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
